name: Jsonpage API
description: Company data API. It serves 14 countries (FR, BE, CH, GB, NO, FI, LV, IE, SE, EE, LT, AU, SG, JP) with one format, completes and checks form input (/v2/autocomplete, /v2/validate), verifies EORI customs numbers (/v2/eori), monitors companies (/v2/monitors, /v2/events) and delivers their changes as signed webhooks, described under x-webhooks since OpenAPI 3.0 has no webhooks section.
